comment: Washout - one Wash knob turns the sound into a cloud (a Transit-style macro). Wash 0..100 moves everything at once: the dry fades down and the wash up (equal power, 100 = wash only), the decay grows from about 1 s to almost endless, the diffusion thickens, the loop darkens (HiCut 12 kHz..3 kHz) and thins (LoCut 25..300 Hz). Tone shifts the HiCut range darker or brighter, Size sets the loop length (27..136 ms). A short loop diffused on every pass: no discrete repeats. Tail sets how long the cloud rings out after Wash goes down (0.1..20 s); Wash 0 lets the tail ring out and then costs nothing. The footswitch is plain on/off with trails.

audio_nop_comment: Set true for a UI-only smoke build before trusting the DSP.

params.name: Wash
params.comment: The macro: 0 = dry only (the tail rings out, then no work), 100 = wash only, long decay, dark and thin. Glides over about 10 ms. Default 50.

params.name: Tone
params.comment: The HiCut range x 0.5 (0, dark) .. x 2 (100, bright); 50 = 12 kHz at Wash 0 down to 3 kHz at Wash 100. Default 50.

params.name: Size
params.comment: Loop length: 27 ms (0) .. 136 ms (100), R 13 % longer. Crossfaded over 23 ms when it moves. Default 50.

params.name: Tail
params.comment: How long the cloud rings out after Wash goes down or the effect goes off: 0.1 s (0) .. 20 s (100), 60 = 2.4 s. The screen shows the time. Default 60.

dsp_cost_comment: Estimate, not measured: the previous Washout (tempo-synced ring, 8 diffusers) estimated 4,100 cycles; this one keeps the 8 diffusers and drops the Time sync, Width and the 680 KB ring (now 28 KB): about 3,400 cycles. Declared = cycles / 75 + 25 %, rounded up (docs/STEREO.md); 1% LOAD = 544 cycles. Arena seal (28 words) included. Re-measure on the pedal (SYSTEM > LOAD).
